features.entropy_rank: mean exp(-sum p log p)/r; p=s/sum(s)
features.energy_entropy_rank: mean exp(-sum q log q)/r; q=s^2/sum(s^2)
features.log_fro: log sqrt(sum_modules sum(s^2)); s already includes LoRA scaling
features.log_nuclear: log sum_modules sum(s); s already includes LoRA scaling
features.log_head_rss: log sqrt(sum_modules max(s)^2); not global operator norm
features.nuclear_ratio: global sum nuclear / source global sum nuclear
features.head_ratio: RSS of module operator norms / source RSS

independent_unit: 18 source checkpoints; modules and repeated evaluations are not independent replicates
design: Separate evaluation waves. Baseline differences within checkpoint and cohort. DG identity and 0+0 controls excluded from fits. Shape rounded at 1e-5 to avoid numerical noise becoming rank evidence.
inference: Source-cluster bootstrap CI, within-checkpoint permutation p, BH FDR per cohort/outcome/feature family; raw correlations diagnostic only.
validation: Nested grouped CV, leave seed/base/task out. Inner source-checkpoint folds select feature, linear/quadratic degree and ridge. Train-only outcome normalization. No target/HNS configuration chosen on held-out results.
limitations: Retrospective association, not causality. Original seed42 training recipes differ from replication seeds; two Llama seed42 labels not fully verified.

numerical_audit_revision.reason: Observed saved-spectrum errors below 6.3e-6; exact preserved budgets otherwise acquire artificial rank correlations from Float32 roundoff
numerical_audit_revision.precision: shape and relative dimensionless features rounded to 1e-5; norm ratios within 1e-5 of 1 snapped to exact invariant; log norm set to source log norm for preserved budgets
numerical_audit_revision.scope: numerical correctness correction before final inference, not selected by predictive performance
